title: AquaTrustAICanonicalReading
description: Authoritative contract for observed and simulated wastewater telemetry observations across all AquaTrust AI layers.

reading_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this canonical reading instance.

dataset_id.description: Registered identifier of the source dataset or simulation generator.

source_record_id.description: Original record row identifier, line index, or simulation step key.

facility_id.description: Standardized unique identifier of the physical or simulated wastewater treatment facility.

sensor_id.description: Standardized hardware telemetry sensor identifier or analytical laboratory assay ID.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp with microsecond resolution (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ).

measurement_stage.description: Wastewater treatment process stage where the measurement was sampled.

parameter.description: Canonical parameter symbol as defined in the AquaTrust Parameter Dictionary.

value.description: Numerical measurement value. Null indicates an unmonitored parameter or missing value.

data_origin.description: Strict origin classification. Real empirical source vs simulated data.

quality_status.description: Deterministic validation outcome. Evaluated strictly by the validation service.

anomaly_status.description: AI Isolation Forest anomaly status. Kept strictly independent of quality_status.

compliance_status.description: Regulatory compliance evaluation outcome. Evaluated strictly by QA/compliance engine.

provenance_id.description: Cryptographic hash or structured provenance identifier linking to raw acquisition manifests.

metadata.description: Optional domain metadata, facility contextual tags, or source file hashes.
